title: Agent Behavioral History Event
description: A timestamped, attributable event that may contribute evidence to an autonomous agent's longitudinal behavioral history.

agent_id.description: Identifier of the agent whose behavior is being recorded.

timestamp.description: Time at which the event occurred.

encounter_id.description: Identifier of the encounter containing this event.

counterparty_id.description: Identifier of another agent or entity involved in the event, when applicable.

context.description: Short description of the relevant interaction context.

content.description: Human- or machine-readable description of what occurred.

source.description: Identifier or URI for the originating record.
